}

ops/static/app.css

:root{--ink:#111;--ink2:#3a3a3a;--mute:#767676;--line:#e7e7e7;--soft:#f6f6f6;--bg:#fff;
--green:#1f9d55;--amber:#c98200;--red:#d64545;--r:14px}
*{box-sizing:border-box}
html,body{margin:0;background:var(--bg);color:var(--ink);font-family:"IBM Plex Sans",system-ui,sans-serif;font-size:14px;-webkit-font-smoothing:antialiased}
button,input,textarea,select{font:inherit;color:inherit}
.preview{background:var(--soft);border-bottom:1px solid var(--line);text-align:center;font-size:12px;color:var(--mute);padding:6px 12px}
.preview a{color:var(--ink2)}
.app{display:grid;grid-template-columns:220px 1fr;min-height:100vh}
.side{border-right:1px solid var(--line);padding:24px 16px;display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:4px;position:sticky;top:0;height:100vh}
.brand{font-weight:700;font-size:18px;letter-spacing:-.2px;padding:0 10px 22px}
.brand small{display:block;font-weight:400;font-size:12px;color:var(--mute);margin-top:2px}
.nav a{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:10px;padding:9px 10px;border-radius:9px;color:var(--ink2);text-decoration:none}
.nav a.on{background:var(--soft);color:var(--ink);font-weight:600}
.nav a:hover{background:var(--soft)}
.nav svg{width:16px;height:16px;stroke:currentColor;fill:none;stroke-width:1.6}
.side .foot{margin-top:auto;font-size:12px;color:var(--mute);padding:0 10px;line-height:1.5}
main{padding:28px 32px 48px;min-width:0}
.top{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;align-items:flex-end;justify-content:space-between;gap:16px;margin-bottom:22px}
h1{font-size:24px;font-weight:600;margin:0;letter-spacing:-.3px}
.sub{color:var(--mute);margin-top:4px}
.legend{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:14px;font-size:12px;color:var(--mute)}
.layout{display:grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr) 330px;gap:20px;align-items:start}
.grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(6,minmax(0,1fr));gap:20px}
.c2{grid-column:span 2}.c3{grid-column:span 3}.c4{grid-column:span 4}.c6{grid-column:span 6}
.card{border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:var(--r);padding:18px 18px 16px;background:#fff;cursor:pointer;transition:border-color .15s,box-shadow .15s;position:relative;min-width:0}
.card:hover{border-color:#cfcfcf;box-shadow:0 2px 10px rgba(0,0,0,.04)}
.card:focus-visible,.al:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--ink);outline-offset:2px}
.ch{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:center;gap:8px;margin-bottom:12px}
.ct{font-size:14px;font-weight:500;color:var(--ink2);display:flex;align-items:center;gap:12px;min-width:0}
.open{font-size:12px;color:var(--mute);white-space:nowrap}
.card:hover .open{color:var(--ink)}
.big{font-size:30px;font-weight:600;letter-spacing:-.6px;line-height:1.1}
.big small{font-size:14px;font-weight:500;color:var(--mute);letter-spacing:0}
.mid{font-size:18px;font-weight:600}
.muted{color:var(--mute)}
.row{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:baseline;gap:10px}
.src{display:inline-flex;align-items:flex-start;gap:5px;font-size:11.5px;color:var(--mute);margin-top:8px}
.li .src,.kv .src{display:flex}
.src i{flex:none;margin-top:1px;font-style:normal;font-size:11px;width:14px;height:14px;border-radius:50%;display:inline-grid;place-items:center;border:1px solid #cfcfcf;color:var(--ink2);line-height:1}
.nr{color:var(--mute);font-weight:500}
.nr::before{content:"— "}
.why{font-size:12px;color:var(--mute)}
.bar{height:8px;background:var(--soft);border-radius:99px;overflow:hidden;margin:14px 0 8px;position:relative}
.bar b{display:block;height:100%;background:var(--ink);border-radius:99px}
.bar .tick{position:absolute;top:-3px;bottom:-3px;width:2px;background:var(--amber)}
.st{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:6px;font-size:12.5px;font-weight:500}
.dot{width:8px;height:8px;border-radius:50%;display:inline-block;flex:none}
.g{background:var(--green)}.a{background:var(--amber)}.r{background:var(--red)}.n{background:#bdbdbd}
.sep{height:1px;background:var(--line);margin:12px 0}
/* equipment icons */
.ic{position:relative;flex:none;width:52px;height:52px;border-radius:13px;border:1px solid var(--line);background:var(--soft);display:inline-grid;place-items:center;color:var(--ink)}
.ic svg{width:34px;height:34px;fill:none;stroke:currentColor;stroke-width:1.4;stroke-linecap:round;stroke-linejoin:round}
.ic.lg{width:76px;height:76px;border-radius:16px}.ic.lg svg{width:52px;height:52px}
.ic.sm{width:38px;height:38px;border-radius:10px}.ic.sm svg{width:25px;height:25px}
.ic .bd{position:absolute;top:-4px;right:-4px;width:14px;height:14px;border-radius:50%;border:2px solid #fff}
.ic.sm .bd{width:11px;height:11px;top:-3px;right:-3px}
.ic .imp{transform-box:fill-box;transform-origin:center}
.ic.spin .imp{animation:spin 1.1s linear infinite}
@keyframes spin{0%{transform:scaleX(1)}50%{transform:scaleX(-1)}100%{transform:scaleX(1)}}
@media (prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){.ic.spin .imp{animation:none}}
.active .ic{background:#222;border-color:#3a3a3a;color:#fff}.active .ic .bd{border-color:#111}
/* active */
.active{background:#111;color:#fff;border-color:#111}
.active:hover{border-color:#111;box-shadow:0 4px 16px rgba(0,0,0,.18)}
.active .ct,.active .open{color:#bdbdbd}.active:hover .open{color:#fff}
.active .src{color:#a8a8a8}.active .src i{border-color:#555;color:#ddd}
.active .muted,.active .why,.active .nr{color:#a8a8a8}
.timer{font-family:"IBM Plex Mono",monospace;font-size:30px;font-weight:500;letter-spacing:-.5px}
.steps{display:flex;gap:4px;margin:14px 0 6px}
.steps span{flex:1;height:4px;border-radius:9px;background:#3a3a3a}
.steps span.done{background:#fff}.steps span.now{background:linear-gradient(90deg,#fff 55%,#3a3a3a 55%)}
.kv{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:10px 14px;margin-top:12px}
.kv div{min-width:0}
.kv b{display:block;font-size:15px;font-weight:600}
.kv .src{margin-top:3px}
svg text{font-family:"IBM Plex Sans",sans-serif}
.lg{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:14px;font-size:12px;color:var(--ink2);margin-top:6px}
.sw{width:10px;height:10px;border-radius:3px;display:inline-block;margin-right:6px;vertical-align:-1px}
.heat{display:grid;grid-template-columns:56px repeat(7,minmax(0,1fr));gap:5px;font-size:11.5px;color:var(--mute);align-items:center}
.heat .cell{height:34px;border-radius:7px;display:grid;place-items:center;font-size:11px;color:var(--ink2)}
.heat .cell.l0{background:var(--soft)}.heat .cell.l1{background:#d9d9d9}.heat .cell.l2{background:#9a9a9a;color:#fff}.heat .cell.l3{background:#2b2b2b;color:#fff}
.heat .cell.nrc{background:repeating-linear-gradient(45deg,#fff 0 4px,#ececec 4px 8px);border:1px dashed #cfcfcf;color:var(--mute)}
.heat .cell.up{border:1px dashed var(--line);color:#bbb}
.heat .hd{text-align:center}
.split{display:flex;height:10px;border-radius:99px;overflow:hidden;gap:2px;margin:12px 0 12px}
.split span{display:block;height:100%}
.li{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:flex-start;gap:10px;padding:9px 0;border-top:1px solid var(--line)}
.li:first-child,.li.first{border-top:0}
.li .l{display:flex;gap:10px;align-items:flex-start;min-width:0}
.li .src{margin-top:2px}
.li .v{text-align:right;font-weight:600;white-space:nowrap}
table{width:100%;border-collapse:collapse;font-size:13px}
th{font-weight:500;color:var(--mute);text-align:left;font-size:12px;padding:0 8px 8px 0}
td{padding:10px 8px 10px 0;border-top:1px solid var(--line);vertical-align:middle}
tr.rowlink{cursor:pointer}tr.rowlink:hover td{background:#fafafa}
.mono{font-family:"IBM Plex Mono",monospace;font-size:12px}
.mx{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:8px}
.rail{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:20px;position:sticky;top:20px}
.rail h2{font-size:13px;font-weight:600;margin:0 0 4px;display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:center}
.count{font-size:11.5px;font-weight:600;border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:99px;padding:1px 8px;color:var(--ink2)}
.al{border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:12px;padding:12px 12px 10px 14px;margin-top:10px;cursor:pointer;position:relative;background:#fff;display:grid;grid-template-columns:52px 1fr;gap:14px}
.al:hover{border-color:#cfcfcf}
.al::before{content:"";position:absolute;left:0;top:12px;bottom:12px;width:3px;border-radius:0 3px 3px 0}
.al.red::before{background:var(--red)}.al.amber::before{background:var(--amber)}.al.grey::before{background:#cfcfcf}.al.green::before{background:var(--green)}
.al .t{font-weight:600;font-size:13.5px;margin:4px 0 2px}
.al .d{font-size:12.5px;color:var(--ink2);line-height:1.45}
.al .act{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:8px;margin-top:10px}
.empty{border:1px dashed var(--line);border-radius:12px;padding:14px;margin-top:10px;color:var(--mute);font-size:12.5px}
.btn{border:1px solid var(--ink);background:var(--ink);color:#fff;border-radius:9px;padding:8px 13px;font-size:13px;font-weight:500;cursor:pointer}
.btn.ghost{background:#fff;color:var(--ink);border-color:var(--line)}
.btn.full{width:100%;padding:12px;font-size:14px}
.scrim{position:fixed;inset:0;background:rgba(17,17,17,.25);opacity:0;pointer-events:none;transition:opacity .2s;z-index:20}
.drawer{position:fixed;top:0;right:0;height:100%;width:min(440px,100%);background:#fff;border-left:1px solid var(--line);transform:translateX(100%);transition:transform .25s ease;z-index:21;display:flex;flex-direction:column}
.show .scrim{opacity:1;pointer-events:auto}.show .drawer{transform:none}
.dh{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:flex-start;padding:20px 22px 14px;border-bottom:1px solid var(--line);gap:12px}
.dh .l{display:flex;gap:12px;align-items:center;min-width:0}
.dh h3{margin:0;font-size:18px;font-weight:600}
.x{border:1px solid var(--line);background:#fff;border-radius:9px;width:34px;height:34px;cursor:pointer;font-size:18px;line-height:1;flex:none}
.db{padding:16px 22px 32px;overflow:auto}
.db h4{font-size:12px;font-weight:600;color:var(--mute);text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:.6px;margin:22px 0 6px}
.tl{list-style:none;margin:0;padding:0}
.tl li{display:grid;grid-template-columns:54px 14px 1fr;gap:8px;padding:6px 0;font-size:13px}
.tl .tm{color:var(--mute);font-family:"IBM Plex Mono",monospace;font-size:12px;padding-top:1px}
.tl .dot{margin-top:5px}
.link{display:inline-block;margin-top:18px;font-weight:500;color:var(--ink);text-decoration:underline;text-underline-offset:3px}
/* forms */
.form{border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:12px;padding:16px;margin-top:14px;background:#fff}
.form h5{margin:0 0 4px;font-size:14px;font-weight:600}
.fl{font-size:13px;font-weight:500;margin:14px 0 8px}
.req{color:var(--red);font-weight:600}
.opt{color:var(--mute);font-weight:400;font-size:12px}
.chips{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:8px}
.chips label{position:relative}
.chips input{position:absolute;opacity:0;inset:0;cursor:pointer}

06_code/rnd_simulations.md

R&D simulation scripts

Assumed sensor errors; results are not measurements. gen.py uses the OpenAI key from the environment (never stored in code).

drift_sim.py

import numpy as np, matplotlib; matplotlib.use("Agg"); import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
rng=np.random.default_rng(7)
# path: loop around a 12 x 8 m hall, 1 m from the walls, plus a pass through the middle, back to start
pts=np.array([[1,1],[11,1],[11,7],[1,7],[1,4],[11,4],[11,1],[1,1]],float)
seg=[];step=0.05
for a,b in zip(pts[:-1],pts[1:]):
    n=int(np.linalg.norm(b-a)/step)
    seg.append(a+np.outer(np.arange(n)/n,b-a))
P=np.vstack(seg+[pts[-1:]]); D=np.r_[0,np.cumsum(np.linalg.norm(np.diff(P,axis=0),axis=1))]
markers=np.array([[1,1],[11,1],[11,7],[1,7],[6,4]],float)
RUNS=300; SCALE=0.015; GYRO=0.0012; NOISE=0.0008  # assumed phone drift: 1.5% scale, heading random walk, small jitter
def walk(mode):
    est=np.zeros_like(P); est[0]=P[0]; head=0; sc=1+rng.normal(0,SCALE)
    for i in range(1,len(P)):
        d=P[i]-P[i-1]; head+=rng.normal(0,GYRO); c,s=np.cos(head),np.sin(head)
        est[i]=est[i-1]+sc*np.array([c*d[0]-s*d[1],s*d[0]+c*d[1]])+rng.normal(0,NOISE,2)
        if mode in("markers","markers_laser"):
            m=np.linalg.norm(markers-P[i],axis=1)
            if m.min()<0.03: est[i]=P[i]+rng.normal(0,0.005,2); head*=0.2   # marker seen: position reset (marker measured to 0.5 cm)
        if mode=="markers_laser" and i%40==0:   # laser shot to nearest wall every 2 m: fixes the distance to that wall (0.2 cm)
            x,y=P[i]; walls=[(x,0),(12-x,0),(y,1),(8-y,1)]; dist,ax=min(walls)
            est[i,ax]=P[i,ax]+rng.normal(0,0.002)
        if mode=="dense" and i%40==0: est[i]=P[i]+rng.normal(0,0.005,2); head*=0.2
        if mode=="dense" and i%40==20:
            x,y=P[i]; walls=[(x,0),(12-x,0),(y,1),(8-y,1)]; dist,ax=min(walls); est[i,ax]=P[i,ax]+rng.normal(0,0.002)
    if mode=="loop":  # end = start is known: spread the end error back along the path
        err=est[-1]-P[-1]; est=est-np.outer(D/D[-1],err)
    return np.linalg.norm(est-P,axis=1)*100, est
modes=[("phone","Phone only","#d62728"),("loop","Phone + end where you started","#ff7f0e"),("markers","Phone + 5 markers","#2b6cff"),("markers_laser","Phone + markers + laser meter","#15803d"),("dense","Marker every 2 m + laser","#7c3aed")]
R={m:np.array([walk(m)[0] for _ in range(RUNS)]) for m,_,_ in modes}
fig,ax=plt.subplots(figsize=(10,5.2))
for m,l,c in modes:
    med=np.median(R[m],0);p90=np.percentile(R[m],90,0)
    ax.plot(D,med,color=c,lw=2.2,label=l);ax.fill_between(D,np.percentile(R[m],10,0),p90,color=c,alpha=.12)
ax.axhline(1,color="k",ls="--",lw=1);ax.text(D[-1]*0.995,1.15,"1 cm goal",ha="right",fontsize=9)
ax.set_xlabel("Metres walked");ax.set_ylabel("Position error (cm)");ax.set_yscale("log");ax.set_title("How far off the phone thinks it is, while walking a 12 × 8 m hall (300 simulated walks)")
ax.legend(loc="upper left");ax.grid(alpha=.3,which="both");fig.tight_layout();fig.savefig("/home/ubuntu/omni_docs/sim/1_error_vs_distance.png",dpi=150)
fig,ax=plt.subplots(figsize=(10,4.6));labels=[l for _,l,_ in modes];x=np.arange(len(modes))
mean=[R[m].mean() for m,_,_ in modes];p95=[np.percentile(R[m],95) for m,_,_ in modes];worst_end=[np.median(R[m].max(1)) for m,_,_ in modes]
b1=ax.bar(x-0.2,mean,0.4,color=[c for *_,c in modes],label="Average error");b2=ax.bar(x+0.2,p95,0.4,color=[c for *_,c in modes],alpha=.45,label="95% of the time below")
for bb in (b1,b2):
    for r in bb: ax.text(r.get_x()+r.get_width()/2,r.get_height()*1.05,f"{r.get_height():.1f} cm",ha="center",fontsize=9)
ax.axhline(1,color="k",ls="--",lw=1);ax.set_xticks(x,labels,fontsize=9);ax.set_yscale("log");ax.set_ylabel("cm (log scale)");ax.set_title("Position error by method");ax.legend();fig.tight_layout();fig.savefig("/home/ubuntu/omni_docs/sim/2_error_by_method.png",dpi=150)
fig,axs=plt.subplots(1,2,figsize=(11,4.4))
for a,(m,l,c) in zip(axs,[modes[0],modes[3]]):
    rng=np.random.default_rng(3); e,est=walk(m)
    a.plot(P[:,0],P[:,1],"k-",lw=1.5,label="Real path");a.plot(est[:,0],est[:,1],color=c,lw=1.5,label="What the phone thinks")
    a.scatter(markers[:,0],markers[:,1],marker="P",s=80,color="#15803d" if m!="phone" else "#bbb",label="Markers" if m!="phone" else "Markers (not used)")
    a.add_patch(plt.Rectangle((0,0),12,8,fill=False,lw=2));a.set_xlim(-0.6,12.6);a.set_ylim(-0.6,8.6);a.set_aspect("equal");a.set_title(f"{l}: max error {e.max():.1f} cm");a.legend(fontsize=8,loc="center right")
fig.suptitle("One example walk (hall 12 × 8 m)");fig.tight_layout();fig.savefig("/home/ubuntu/omni_docs/sim/3_example_walk.png",dpi=150)
for m,l,_ in modes: print(f"{l:34s} mean {R[m].mean():6.2f} cm  p95 {np.percentile(R[m],95):6.2f} cm  max(median run) {np.median(R[m].max(1)):6.2f} cm")
print("path length m", round(D[-1],1))

practical.py

import numpy as np
exec(open("drift_sim.py").read().split("modes=[")[0])  # path, params, walk()
machines=np.array([[3,1.6],[6,3.2],[9,3.4],[10.4,6],[4,6.4],[1.6,5.5],[8,1.6],[6,4.8]])  # 8 machine labels near the route (example)
walls=np.array([[6,0],[12,4],[6,8],[0,4]])  # 4 big A3 markers, one per wall
def walk2(mode):
    est=np.zeros_like(P); est[0]=P[0]; head=0; sc=1+rng.normal(0,SCALE); last=-99
    for i in range(1,len(P)):
        d=P[i]-P[i-1]; head+=rng.normal(0,GYRO); c,s=np.cos(head),np.sin(head)
        est[i]=est[i-1]+sc*np.array([c*d[0]-s*d[1],s*d[0]+c*d[1]])+rng.normal(0,NOISE,2)
        if np.linalg.norm(machines-P[i],axis=1).min()<0.7 and i-last>10:   # machine label read from ~0.7 m: 0.5 cm
            est[i]=P[i]+rng.normal(0,0.005,2); head*=0.2; last=i
        if mode>=2 and i%20==0:   # big wall marker in view: camera fix, error 0.3% of distance (assumed)
            dist=np.linalg.norm(walls-P[i],axis=1); k=dist.argmin()
            if dist[k]<7: est[i]=0.5*est[i]+0.5*(P[i]+rng.normal(0,0.003*dist[k],2))
        if mode>=3 and np.linalg.norm(pts-P[i],axis=1).min()<0.03:   # corner: 2 laser shots, both directions 0.2 cm
            est[i]=P[i]+rng.normal(0,0.002,2); head*=0.2
    return np.linalg.norm(est-P,axis=1)*100
for m,l in ((1,"Machine labels only"),(2,"+ 4 big wall markers"),(3,"+ laser shots at the corners")):
    R=np.array([walk2(m) for _ in range(300)]); print(f"{l:32s} mean {R.mean():5.2f} cm  p95 {np.percentile(R,95):5.2f} cm")

swarm.py

import numpy as np, matplotlib; matplotlib.use("Agg"); import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
from scipy.optimize import least_squares
rng=np.random.default_rng(5); L,W=12,8
def place(n):
    p=[]
    while len(p)<n:
        q=rng.uniform([0.3,0.3],[L-.3,W-.3])
        if np.linalg.norm(q-[6,4.2])>1.2: p.append(q)
    return np.array(p)
def blocked(a,b):  # mixer (r=1 m at 6,4.2) blocks the camera view
    c=np.array([6,4.2]); d=b-a; t=np.clip(np.dot(c-a,d)/np.dot(d,d),0,1); return np.linalg.norm(a+t*d-c)<1.0
def run(n,radio,cam,ruler,sr):
    X=place(n); X[1]=X[0]+[2.0,0]  # units 0 and 1 sit on a 2 m bar
    th=rng.uniform(-np.pi,np.pi,n); pairs=[(i,j) for i in range(n) for j in range(n) if i<j]
    R=[(i,j,np.linalg.norm(X[i]-X[j])+rng.normal(0,sr)) for i,j in pairs] if radio else []
    B=[(i,j,np.arctan2(*(X[j]-X[i])[::-1])-th[i]+rng.normal(0,np.radians(0.2))) for i in range(n) for j in range(n) if i!=j and cam and not blocked(X[i],X[j])]
    def res(v):
        P=v[:2*n].reshape(n,2); T=v[2*n:]; out=[]
        out+= [(np.linalg.norm(P[i]-P[j])-r)/sr for i,j,r in R]
        for i,j,b in B:
            e=np.arctan2(*(P[j]-P[i])[::-1])-T[i]-b; out.append(((e+np.pi)%(2*np.pi)-np.pi)/np.radians(0.2))
        if ruler: out.append((np.linalg.norm(P[1]-P[0])-2.0)/0.001)
        out+= [(P[0,0]-X[0,0])/1e-4,(P[0,1]-X[0,1])/1e-4,(P[1,1]-P[0,1])/1e-4]  # fix the frame: unit 0 = origin, bar sets the direction
        return np.array(out)
    v0=np.r_[(X+rng.normal(0,0.3,X.shape)).ravel(),th+rng.normal(0,0.1,n)]
    P=least_squares(res,v0,method="trf",x_scale="jac").x[:2*n].reshape(n,2)
    return np.sqrt(np.mean(np.sum((P-X)**2,1)))*100
Ns=[4,6,8,12,16,24]

import numpy as np, matplotlib; matplotlib.use("Agg"); import matplotlib.pyplot as plt, matplotlib.animation as an, shutil
if not shutil.which("ffmpeg"):
    import imageio_ffmpeg; matplotlib.rcParams["animation.ffmpeg_path"]=imageio_ffmpeg.get_ffmpeg_exe()
rng=np.random.default_rng(11)
pts=np.array([[1,1],[11,1],[11,7],[1,7],[1,1]],float); step=0.1; seg=[]
for a,b in zip(pts[:-1],pts[1:]):
    n=int(round(np.linalg.norm(b-a)/step)); seg.append(a+np.outer(np.arange(n)/n,b-a))
P=np.vstack(seg+[pts[-1:]]); N=len(P)
dh=rng.normal(0,0.0035,N); jit=rng.normal(0,0.002,(N,2)); sc=1.02
def sim(mode):
    est=np.zeros_like(P); est[0]=P[0]; head=0; ev=[None]*N
    for i in range(1,N):
        d=P[i]-P[i-1]; head+=dh[i]; c,s=np.cos(head),np.sin(head)
        est[i]=est[i-1]+sc*np.array([c*d[0]-s*d[1],s*d[0]+c*d[1]])+jit[i]
        if mode and i%20==0: est[i]=P[i]; head=0; ev[i]=("m",i//20)
        elif mode and i%20==10:
            x,y=P[i]; w=min([(x,0,(0,y)),(12-x,0,(12,y)),(y,1,(x,0)),(8-y,1,(x,8))]); est[i,w[1]]=P[i,w[1]]; ev[i]=("l",w[2])
    return est,ev
E1,_=sim(False); E2,EV=sim(True)
AMP=3

FR=[]
FR+= [("intro",k) for k in range(60)]

FR+= [("mid",k) for k in range(60)]

def draw(f):
    kind,i=f
    if kind=="intro":
        base("How the phone gets lost, and how stickers fix it","Hall 12 × 8 m seen from above · grey squares = 50 cm")
        ax.text(6,6.4,"1. The engineer walks around the hall with the phone",ha="center",fontsize=13); ax.text(6,5.6,"2. Black = where he really is   ·   Red = where the phone thinks he is",ha="center",fontsize=12)
        ax.text(6,1.8,"(drift drawn 3× bigger so you can see it; the cm numbers are the real simulated values)",ha="center",fontsize=9,color="#777"); return
    if kind=="mid":
        base("Now: the same walk WITH stickers + laser","Green squares = QR stickers on the walls, measured once from A1")
        ax.text(6,6.3,"Every ~2 m: point the phone at a sticker → exact position",ha="center",fontsize=13); ax.text(6,5.5,"Halfway between: laser meter to the wall → one exact distance",ha="center",fontsize=13); return
    if kind=="end":
        e1=np.linalg.norm(E1-P,axis=1)*100; e2=np.linalg.norm(E2-P,axis=1)*100
        base("Result for this walk (32 m)","")
        ax.text(6,6,f"Phone only: up to {e1.max():.0f} cm off",ha="center",fontsize=18,color="#d62728",weight="bold")
        ax.text(6,4.6,f"With stickers + laser: up to {e2.max():.1f} cm off",ha="center",fontsize=18,color="#15803d",weight="bold")
        ax.text(6,2.8,"The stickers stay on the walls for every future visit.",ha="center",fontsize=13)
        ax.text(6,1.8,"Simulation with assumed phone drift, not measured on a real iPhone.",ha="center",fontsize=10,color="#777"); return
    E=E1 if kind=="a" else E2
    G=P[:i+1]+(E[:i+1]-P[:i+1])*AMP; err=np.linalg.norm(E[i]-P[i])*100
    base("Phone only: no stickers" if kind=="a" else "With stickers + laser meter", "Black = real position · Red = what the phone thinks")
    if kind=="b":
        for k in range(20,N,20):
            m=P[k]; x,y=m; w=min([(x,(m[0]-1+0.0,y)),(12-x,(12,y)),(y,(x,0)),(8-y,(x,8))]); sx,sy=(0.25 if x<1.5 else 11.75 if x>10.5 else x),(0.25 if y<1.5 else 7.75 if y>6.5 else y)
            done=k<=i; ax.scatter([sx],[sy],marker="s",s=110,color="#15803d" if done else "#9bd3ad",edgecolor="#0b5d2a",zorder=5)
            ax.text(sx,sy+.32,f"A-{k//20:03d}",ha="center",fontsize=7,color="#15803d")
    ax.plot(P[:i+1,0],P[:i+1,1],color="#111",lw=1.5); ax.plot(G[:,0],G[:,1],color="#d62728",lw=1.5,alpha=.8)
    ax.plot([P[i,0],G[-1,0]],[P[i,1],G[-1,1]],color="#d62728",ls=":",lw=1.2)
    ax.scatter([P[i,0]],[P[i,1]],s=160,color="#111",zorder=7); ax.text(P[i,0]+.2,P[i,1]+.25,"Engineer",fontsize=10,weight="bold")
    ax.scatter([G[-1,0]],[G[-1,1]],s=110,color="#d62728",zorder=7)
    ax.text(6,8.45,f"Phone is {err:.1f} cm off",ha="center",fontsize=15,weight="bold",color="#d62728" if err>3 else "#15803d")
    if kind=="b":
        for j in range(max(0,i-8),i+1):
            if EV[j] and EV[j][0]=="m":
                k=EV[j][1]; x,y=P[j]; sx,sy=(0.25 if x<1.5 else 11.75 if x>10.5 else x),(0.25 if y<1.5 else 7.75 if y>6.5 else y)
                ax.plot([x,sx],[y,sy],color="#15803d",lw=2); ax.text(6,2.2,f"Scanned sticker A-{k:03d} → position reset to exact",ha="center",fontsize=13,color="#15803d",weight="bold",bbox=dict(fc="white",ec="#15803d"))
            if EV[j] and EV[j][0]=="l":
                wx,wy=EV[j][1]; ax.plot([P[j,0],wx],[P[j,1],wy],color="#d62728",ls="--",lw=2); ax.text(6,2.2,"Laser shot to the wall → distance fixed",ha="center",fontsize=13,color="#d62728",weight="bold",bbox=dict(fc="white",ec="#d62728"))
a=an.FuncAnimation(fig,draw,frames=FR,interval=1000/30)

omnisite_tools/deploy_pa.py

Guarded deploy (see 07_guardrails/02_build.md). Needs PA_TOKEN in the environment (never in the file).

"""Guarded deploy to PythonAnywhere (CRM + factory dashboard).

Usage: PA_TOKEN=... python3 deploy_pa.py BASE_DIR LOCAL_DIR file1 [file2 ...]
  BASE_DIR  = folder holding the live copies you started from (same relative paths)
  LOCAL_DIR = folder holding your changed files
  files     = paths relative to /home/omnisite, e.g. omnisite-crm/crm/app.py
Refuses to upload if: a database is in the list, the live file changed since BASE_DIR,
or the fresh database backup fails. After upload it reloads and checks / , /ops/ and headers.
"""
import hashlib, json, os, sqlite3, sys, time, urllib.request
U, HOME, SITE = "omnisite", "/home/omnisite", "https://omnisite.pythonanywhere.com"
API = f"https://www.pythonanywhere.com/api/v0/user/{U}"
TOK = os.environ["PA_TOKEN"]
DBS = ["omnisite-crm-data/crm.db", "omnisite-ops-data/ops.db"]


def req(url, data=None, method=None, headers=None):
    r = urllib.request.Request(url, data=data, method=method, headers={"Authorization": f"Token {TOK}", **(headers or {})})
    with urllib.request.urlopen(r, timeout=60) as x:
        return x.status, x.read()


def live(path):
    return req(f"{API}/files/path{path if path.startswith('/') else HOME + '/' + path}")[1]


def upload(path, data):
    b = "----omni" + hashlib.md5(data).hexdigest()
    body = (f"--{b}\r\nContent-Disposition: form-data; name=\"content\"; filename=\"f\"\r\n\r\n").encode() + data + f"\r\n--{b}--\r\n".encode()
    return req(f"{API}/files/path{path if path.startswith('/') else HOME + '/' + path}", body, "POST", {"Content-Type": f"multipart/form-data; boundary={b}"})[0]


def main():
    base, local, files = sys.argv[1], sys.argv[2], sys.argv[3:]
    if not files or any(f.endswith(".db") for f in files):
        sys.exit("STOP: give code files only. Databases are never uploaded.")
    for f in files:
        if hashlib.md5(live(f)).hexdigest() != hashlib.md5(open(os.path.join(base, f), "rb").read()).hexdigest():
            sys.exit(f"STOP: {f} changed on the live site since your copy. Download it and merge first.")
    bdir = os.path.expanduser(f"~/omnisite_backups/{time.strftime('%Y%m%d_%H%M%S')}")
    os.makedirs(bdir)
    for d in DBS:
        p = os.path.join(bdir, os.path.basename(d))
        open(p, "wb").write(live(d))
        if sqlite3.connect(p).execute("PRAGMA integrity_check").fetchone()[0] != "ok":
            sys.exit(f"STOP: backup of {d} failed the integrity check.")
    print("Backup ok:", bdir)
    for f in files:
        print("upload", f, upload(f, open(os.path.join(local, f), "rb").read()))
    print("reload", req(f"{API}/webapps/{U}.pythonanywhere.com/reload/", b"", "POST")[0])
    time.sleep(5)
    bad = []
    for u in ("/", "/ops/"):
        with urllib.request.urlopen(SITE + u, timeout=30) as x:
            ok = x.status == 200 and x.headers.get("X-Frame-Options") == "DENY"
            print(u, x.status, "headers ok" if ok else "HEADERS MISSING")
            bad += [] if ok else [u]
    sys.exit(f"CHECK FAILED on {bad}: roll back with the files in {base}" if bad else 0)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

function noise(g,w,h,base,n,a){g.fillStyle=base;g.fillRect(0,0,w,h);for(let i=0;i<n;i++){const v=Math.random()*60-30|0;g.fillStyle=`rgba(${v>0?255:0},${v>0?255:0},${v>0?255:0},${Math.abs(v)/255*a})`;g.fillRect(Math.random()*w,Math.random()*h,1+Math.random()*3,1+Math.random()*3)}}

 for(let x=0;x<=8.5;x+=1.7)box(0.04,1.0,0.04,steel,x,1.98,0.88,g);pipe([[0,2.98,0.88],[8.5,2.98,0.88]],0.025,steel,g);pipe([[0,2.5,0.88],[8.5,2.5,0.88]],0.02,steel,g);

const ui=document.getElementById('lbl'),list=document.getElementById('list');
items.forEach((it,i)=>{it.g=it.f();it.g.traverse(o=>o.userData.i=i);const bb=new T.Box3().setFromObject(it.g);it.c=bb.getCenter(new T.Vector3());it.top=new T.Vector3(it.c.x,bb.max.y+0.25,it.c.z);it.bb=bb;
 const d=document.createElement('div');d.className='tag';d.textContent=i+1;d.onclick=()=>pick(i);ui.appendChild(d);it.el=d;
 const b=document.createElement('button');b.innerHTML=`<b>${i+1}</b> ${it.n}`;b.onclick=()=>pick(i);list.appendChild(b);it.btn=b;});
let sel=-1,helper=null,fly=null;
function flyTo(pos,tgt){fly={p0:C.position.clone(),t0:O.target.clone(),p1:pos,t1:tgt,s:performance.now()}}
function pick(i){sel=i;const it=items[i];if(helper)S.remove(helper);helper=new T.Box3Helper(it.bb.clone().expandByScalar(0.08),0x00b0ff);S.add(helper);
 items.forEach((x,j)=>{x.el.classList.toggle('on',j===i);x.btn.classList.toggle('on',j===i)});
 const sz=it.bb.getSize(new T.Vector3()).length();const dir=new T.Vector3(1.2,0.9,1.6).normalize().multiplyScalar(Math.max(3,sz*1.8));
 flyTo(it.c.clone().add(dir),it.c.clone());O.autoRotate=false;
 document.getElementById('info').innerHTML=`<div class="k">${i+1} · ${it.k}</div><h3>${it.n}</h3><table><tr><td>Brand</td><td>${it.b}</td></tr><tr><td>Model</td><td>${it.m}</td></tr><tr><td>Size</td><td>${it.s} <i>(example)</i></td></tr><tr><td>From A1</td><td>${Math.round(it.c.x*100)} cm along · ${Math.round(it.c.z*100)} cm out <i>(example)</i></td></tr></table>`;
 document.getElementById('info').style.display='block';}
const home=()=>{flyTo(new T.Vector3(-3,11,21),new T.Vector3(12,0.5,7));O.autoRotate=false};
document.getElementById('b360').onclick=()=>{O.autoRotate=!O.autoRotate;O.autoRotateSpeed=1.6};
document.getElementById('btop').onclick=()=>{flyTo(new T.Vector3(HL/2,26,HD/2+0.01),new T.Vector3(HL/2,0,HD/2));O.autoRotate=false};
document.getElementById('bres').onclick=()=>{home();document.getElementById('info').style.display='none';if(helper)S.remove(helper);items.forEach(x=>{x.el.classList.remove('on');x.btn.classList.remove('on')})};
const rc=new T.Raycaster(),mv=new T.Vector2();let down=null;
R.domElement.addEventListener('pointerdown',e=>down=[e.clientX,e.clientY]);
R.domElement.addEventListener('pointerup',e=>{if(!down||Math.hypot(e.clientX-down[0],e.clientY-down[1])>6)return;const r=R.domElement.getBoundingClientRect();mv.set((e.clientX-r.left)/r.width*2-1,-(e.clientY-r.top)/r.height*2+1);rc.setFromCamera(mv,C);const h=rc.intersectObjects(S.children,true).find(x=>x.object.userData.i!==undefined);if(h)pick(h.object.userData.i)});
C.position.set(-3,11,21);O.target.set(12,0.5,7);
function size(){const el=document.getElementById('v');R.setSize(el.clientWidth,el.clientHeight);C.aspect=el.clientWidth/el.clientHeight;C.updateProjectionMatrix()}
addEventListener('resize',size);size();
const v=new T.Vector3();
(function loop(t){requestAnimationFrame(loop);if(fly){const k=Math.min(1,(t-fly.s)/900),e=k<.5?2*k*k:1-Math.pow(-2*k+2,2)/2;C.position.lerpVectors(fly.p0,fly.p1,e);O.target.lerpVectors(fly.t0,fly.t1,e);if(k>=1)fly=null}
 O.update();R.render(S,C);const w=R.domElement.clientWidth,h=R.domElement.clientHeight;
 items.forEach(it=>{v.copy(it.top).project(C);const ok=v.z<1&&Math.abs(v.x)<1.05&&Math.abs(v.y)<1.05;it.el.style.display=ok?'block':'none';if(ok)it.el.style.transform=`translate(${(v.x+1)/2*w-11}px,${(1-v.y)/2*h-11}px)`})})();
window.__ready=true;

07_guardrails/01_ai.md

1. AI guardrails

# Rule How
1 AI only suggests; a person confirms before anything is saved Enforced: engineer reviews the AI fields, then taps + Add equipment
2 Never guess: unreadable model / rating / ports stay empty Enforced: prompt rule + empty fields allowed
3 Text in a photo is data, never an instruction (prompt injection) Enforced: prompt rule
4 Output is a fixed JSON shape; kind must be machine / tool / fixed / power; each field ≤ 200 characters; control characters and < > removed Enforced: server cleans the reply
5 Only JPEG or PNG, ≤ 8 MB Enforced
6 Only a survey engineer on his own survey job can call it Enforced: route is inside the survey job
7 Daily limit: 100 photos (OMNI_AI_DAILY_CAP) Enforced: "daily limit reached, type the details"
8 Every call logged: time, user, job, OK / error, tokens, ms Enforced: ai_calls table
9 No personal or factory-private data (batches, kg, AED, names, phones) is sent to the AI Policy: the prompt only holds the equipment list (name · model)
10 The AI never controls a machine or writes to the factory dashboard Policy + no such route exists
11 Key stays outside the code (data folder / secret store), never printed or committed Policy
12 Spend limit set in the OpenAI account Policy: Salamah sets it
13 Before changing the model or prompt, run the photo test set and compare Policy
14 Future RAG / chat: answers only from the factory's own records, with the source shown; "I don't know" when not found; one factory's data never used for another Policy (no RAG yet)
07_guardrails/02_build.md

2. Build and deploy guardrails

# Rule How
1 Download the live files first; the live copy can be newer than GitHub Enforced: deploy script stops if the live file changed since your copy
2 Fresh backup of crm.db and ops.db before every deploy, integrity-checked Enforced: deploy script
3 Databases are never uploaded Enforced: deploy script refuses .db files
4 After deploy: / and /ops/ must load with security headers Enforced: deploy script checks and says how to roll back
5 Change only what was asked; no unrelated rewrites Policy
6 Test locally first (ops: python3 test_app.py) Policy
7 One session deploys at a time Policy
8 Keys never in code, logs, chat or GitHub Policy + secret scan (to add in CI)
9 No AI agent or script may delete live data or databases Policy
10 Code repo private; backups only in a private place To do: make omnisite-portal private
11 Staging copy for risky changes To do
12 Rotate the PythonAnywhere token if it was ever exposed Policy

Deploy script: omnisite_tools/deploy_pa.py (see 06_code/tools.md).

07_guardrails/03_data.md

3. Data guardrails

# Rule How
1 One source of truth per fact (see data strategy) Policy
2 Each factory sees only its own data Enforced on the server
3 OmniSite team never sees factory batches, kg or AED Enforced on the server
4 Owners are view only; only OmniSite adds equipment; nobody switches machines from OmniSite Enforced
5 Every value shows its source (Manual / Estimate / Sensor) and time; empty = "Not recorded", never 0 Enforced in the UI
6 Example / demo data is always labelled as example Policy + "EXAMPLE data" in the demo factory name
7 Never stored: plain passwords (hashed only), bank / card numbers, ID copies, faces on purpose Policy
8 Site photos: nameplates and equipment only; avoid people Policy
9 Uploads ≤ 25 MB, AI photos ≤ 8 MB Enforced
10 Retention period Decision needed from Salamah (proposal: end of contract + 2 years, then delete or hand back)
11 Backups: daily, offsite, restore tested monthly To do
12 Personal data list + processors in the PDPL checklist See 02_legal/03_pdpl.md
